svg.title: Whitney two-sphere: four times on the same spatial scale
svg.desc: Exact initial data at t=0 and numerical equivariant mean curvature flow at t=0.03, 0.06 and 0.09. Each panel pairs an R4-to-R3 surface projection with its planar figure-eight profile. All dimensions use one spatial scale. Extra crossings can arise in projection; the true immersion has one double point at the origin.

g.text: Whitney sphere under mean curvature flow
n = 2 · surface in R⁴ · fixed spatial scale · positive times are numerical
The flow is not self-similar. These snapshots stop before the singularity; t = 0.09 is not T.
